title: AI Recipes 001: Call or Be Called
summary: Eight practical build recipes for AI phone and voice agents: inbound helplines, latency, barge-in, warm hand-off, multi-channel doors, regulated industries, consented outbound calls, and the call people hope to get.
boundary: Build recipes, not legal advice. Vendor features and rules change; every line was read on the publisher's page on 2026-11-08, with federal regulations read on Cornell LII's copy.

recipes.name: The Product Line
recipes.core: Match what the caller is holding with a catalog lookup tool, confirm it aloud, answer only from approved text, hand off the rest.

recipes.name: The Speed Run
recipes.core: Budget latency per step and stream everything. Twilio's starting baseline is about 1,115 ms median mouth to ear, 1,400 ms at the limit.

recipes.name: Let Them Cut In
recipes.core: Semantic turn detection, barge-in on by default, flush audio and trim history to what the caller heard, patient turns for numbers.

recipes.name: The Warm Hand-off
recipes.core: Brief the human privately, connect, leave; return to the caller if no one answers; count a transfer only when a human answered.

recipes.name: Many Doors, One Clerk
recipes.core: One brain across phone, web voice, chat, SMS, WhatsApp, a QR on the package and a read-only MCP door for agents.

recipes.name: The Regulated Kitchen
recipes.core: Rules in tools, approved answer bank, recording notice, health and legal questions to trained humans, counsel review.

recipes.name: Be Called, Properly
recipes.core: Written consent, DNC scrub, local calling hours, business ID first, automated opt-out, honor stop words within ten business days.

recipes.name: The Call You Hope to Get
recipes.core: Opt-in members, one short question, published free-entry rules, never ask for money, reveal the reward where people can trust it.

rules_checked.rule: AI-generated voices are artificial voices under the TCPA
Massachusetts telephone solicitation: 8 a.m. to 8 p.m., state no-call list, recorded-message sales calls barred
Massachusetts cannabis advertising: 85% audience 21+, no therapeutic claims, no marketing gifts, discounts, points or loyalty programs
Telemarketing prize promotions: disclose odds, no purchase necessary, free entry method
